name: Meteora DAMM v2

actions.label: Withdraw all
actions.description: Claim fees, remove all unlocked liquidity, claim rewards, and close the position and burn its NFT when nothing remains locked.

supported: Position NFTs (Token-2022) held by the connected wallet in any token account; unlocked, vesting and permanently locked positions; pool and reward tokens on SPL Token or Token-2022 without an active transfer hook; WSOL stays wrapped

token2022.receipt: measured by simulation on the wallet's own accounts; withheld transfer fees are reported separately

liquidityMinimums: token_a_amount_threshold and token_b_amount_threshold are 0; see docs/meteora-damm-operations.md
frozenRewardVault: claim_reward with skip_reward = 1 forfeits that reward so the principal can be withdrawn; stated in the review
